# LEO SNOW — Full Site Information

## Identity

- Name: LEO SNOW
- Taglines: "Ghana Boy With A Different Flow", "The Storm From Africa", "The global takeover begins here"
- Genre: Afrobeats, Alté, Hip-Hop, Experimental
- Origin: Ghana
- Booking: leosnowbookings@gmail.com

## Biography

Leo Snow is the storm out of Africa — where afrobeats, alté and street soul collide into one cold wave. Born in the noise, raised in the frequency, he turns every track into a blizzard of melody and motion. This isn't just music; it's a storm designed to move your pulse.

## Site structure

The official website (https://inventor40028.github.io/leo-snow/) is a dark-themed multi-page experience built around a green (#089908) accent with yellow (#FFDE21) and red (#eb0905) highlights. Scrolling from the hero triggers a cinematic zoom into the content.

### Home (index.html)
Single-page experience with these sections:

- **Hero**: Full-screen photography per device, the LEO SNOW logo, the boxed tagline "Ghana Boy With / A Different Flow" and a Stream Latest button that jumps to the music section. A vertical social pill on mobile and header icons on desktop.
- **Videos**: Up to three official music videos embedded from YouTube, behind a giant ghost "Videos" label.
- **Music (Releases)**: Cover-art cards, each labeled with its type (Single, EP, Mixtape, Album) and year. A "Stream" toggle on each card reveals the platforms the release is available on: Spotify, Audiomack, Boomplay, Deezer, Apple Music, YouTube Music and custom links. Desktop shows 4 releases, mobile shows 8, with a "More Music" button to the full discography page when there are more.
- **Events (Shows)**: White cards over a full-bleed event photograph: venue, date, city, a Tickets button when tickets are available, and a calendar icon that adds the show to Google or Apple Calendar as a reminder.
- **About / Showcase Room**: The artist's story paired with a fan of showcase images. Clicking the focused card flips it open in 3D to reveal the image alongside its story; the first image carries the artist's own story. Arrow navigation walks through the images.
- **Booking**: A "Get in touch" panel with the booking email and a Name / Email / Message form. Submissions are stored in the site's Supabase backend. A "Follow the storm" socials rail sits under the Listen card on desktop and under the form on mobile.
- **Available On**: A fixed glass widget (bottom-right, desktop) linking to streaming platforms.

### Music page (music.html)
The full discography: every release with cover art, type and year, each with its own Stream toggle expanding its platform links. Sticky header and live Supabase updates.

### About page (about.html)
The full artist bio and a tilted, grayscale-to-color framed portrait, plus a "Follow The Storm" section: a grid of platform cards with hover-fill effects and a scrolling marquee of platform names, over a giant ghost "Socials" label.

### Contact page (contact.html)
Bookings and inquiries: the booking email card, a "Listen" card linking to the discography, a "Follow the storm" socials rail, and a Name / Email / Message form writing to the Supabase inbox.

### Merch page (merch.html)
The official store landing — a branded "Coming Soon" with a ghost "Merch" label and an Instagram call to follow the drop.

### Legal pages
- **terms.html**: Terms of Service covering content use, intellectual property, events and tickets, merchandise, bookings, third-party links and user conduct.
- **privacy.html**: Privacy Policy covering what the contact form collects, how messages are stored, retention, user rights and children's privacy. The site uses no cookies or tracking pixels.

## Platforms

- YouTube: https://youtube.com
- SoundCloud: https://soundcloud.com
- Apple Music: https://music.apple.com
- Audiomack: https://audiomack.com
- Instagram, TikTok, X (Twitter), Facebook, Threads, Snapchat, Spotify: linked from the site header, hero pill, contact rail and the about page's Follow The Storm section. All editable from the admin Control Room.

## Technical notes

- Static multi-page site hosted on GitHub Pages
- Content served from a Supabase backend (site_content + messages tables) with realtime updates
- Structured data (JSON-LD MusicGroup + Events) injected at runtime
- Socials are admin-managed and deep-merged over platform defaults, so an empty backend never wipes the seeded links
- Admin/management interface is not publicly linked (disallowed in robots.txt)
